hash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 serialized WorldSaveData JSON
read: highest valid slot; legacy migration if neither slot valid
write: stage verified .tmp file into inactive slot then promote; keep previous valid slot
dataLossPrevention: never silently reset when persisted data exists but is unreadable
integrityGuarantees: detect corrupted/incomplete writes and recover older slot
limitations: last successfully saved checkpoint can be older than latest failed write
not a transactional filesystem or secure anti-cheat store
